      bbolt.pmFresh X →
        ⊢
          ∀ Φ,
            bbolt.wtxWQ K tx r m q X ∗
                typedPointsto c { bucket' := bl, stack' := stk } (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                  ownSlice stk els0 (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                    ownSliceCap go_etcd_io.bbolt.elemRef stk (DFrac.own 1) ∗ bbolt.keyR X.v key kr kb -∗
              (▷
                  ∀ k v fl,
                    (∃ stk' els pids,
                        bbolt.wtxWQ K tx r m q X ∗
                          typedPointsto c { bucket' := bl, stack' := stk' } (DFrac.own 1) ∗

                                bbolt.keyR X.v key kr kb ∗
                                  ⌜bbolt.lPath X bl els pids ∧ bbolt.lRoutes X bl els pids kb⌝ ∗
                                    match (bbolt.lLeaf X bl pids)[bbolt.wsIdx (bbolt.lLeaf X bl pids) kb]? with
                                    | some w =>
                                      ⌜k ≠ slice.nil ∧ fl = w.flags⌝ ∗
                                        bbolt.srcOwn X.v k (bbolt.leafSrc X bl w.ks) w.key ∗
                                          bbolt.srcOwn X.v v (bbolt.leafSrc X bl w.vs) w.value
                                    | none => ⌜k = slice.nil ∧ v = slice.nil ∧ fl = W32 0⌝) -∗
                      Φ ((intoVal k, intoVal v), intoVal fl)) -∗
                WP
                  ((intoVal (methods go_etcd_io.bbolt.Cursor.ty.PointerType go!"seek" (intoVal c)))
                    (intoVal key))

theorem bbolt.wtxW_ltree_len [hos : HasExt osFsExt] (K : bbolt.BC) (tx : Loc) (r : bbolt.TxReg) (m :
    Bool) (X : bbolt.WX) (bl : Loc) (B : bbolt.BRec) (p : w64) (lf : Bool) (ws : List bbolt.WEntry)
    (hB : X.t.bs !! bl = some B) (hloc : bbolt.bktLocalOK X bl) (hl : bbolt.ltree X bl p = some (lf,
    ws)) : bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X ⊢ bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X ∗ ⌜ws.length < 2 ^ 63⌝
